why: Issue #692. The loader returns the first module that imports, whether or not it exports `chromium`. Every tool then calls `chromium.launch` on undefined and dies with a TypeError far from the cause, instead of the loader moving on to the next candidate and, failing that, naming what it tried. Of the 11 copies this loader replaced, 7 carried the check (gl/run, gl/idle-cost, baseline/beacon-check, baseline/run, visual/verify and both uikit scripts); audio/render, visual/roundtrip, gallery/run and screens/run did not, so for those four this is a behaviour gained, not kept. Killed by the aggregate-error case, whose firefox-only package now resolves at its second attempt.
killedBy: shared playwright loader skips a module with no chromium export and names every attempt in the error
